snippet.title: Mayhem À La Carte — Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4631740/Mayhem_A_La_Carte

Mayhem À la carte is a 4-player co-op FPS where you run a catering service for organized crime. Prep ingredients, cook the order, and fight off whatever's trying to stop the delivery, using the food itself as a weapon when things get out of hand.

🔪 Cooperative role distribution. Prep, combat, and delivery, split across your crew
🍽️ Weaponized food. Every ingredient and finished dish can double as a weapon
🌍 Missions across the criminal underworld. Starting in the USA, with more to come

Join the Discord: discord.com/invite/RzNPvYWrg
Follow on X: x.com/mayhemalacarte
Instagram: instagram.com/mayhemalacarte
TikTok: tiktok.com/mayhemalacarte

#MayhemALaCarte #CoOpGame #IndieGame
